I did not finish primary school, but I can count my money and read the name on a seed bag. This plot is not mine — I rent it — so I will not waste cash on fertilizer the owner will benefit from. I kept bean seed from last season, and my sister and I will weed by hand when the rains come. My family will spend about 25 days on this plot this season, and I will not hire anyone because there is no extra money for wages.
